correctness.rationale: For left F_L(x,y)=(x+y+1,0) and right F_R=(y+1,-2x), the only right fixed point is X=(1/3,-2/3) with F_R²(z)-X=-2(z-X). Every other right itinerary eventually meets left and collapses onto the horizontal axis, which reaches the four-edge invariant K by bounded translation; first-return section E=[0,1]x{0} has three exact branches 4u on (0,1/4) with roof 6, 4u-1 on (1/4,1/2) and 2-2u on (1/2,1) with roofs 5. Independent Fraction rational iterates at u=1/8,3/8,3/4 confirmed all 3 returns. Full branches give iid Lebesgue p=(1/4,1/4,1/2), mean roof 21/4 and tower entropy (2/7)log2. Compact renewal graph Perron equation lambda^-6+2lambda^-5=1 yields log lambda; independent numerical 0.19804205158856 vs 0.20685980710198. Original-time entropy, not return-time entropy; numerical tests supplement explicit symbolic tower proof.
